I had decided to try a week of tripping on 4 acetoxy dmt. I believe this to be nearly indistinguishable from taking magic mushrooms, having grown them and have significant experience with both to support this. I don't want to get into the details of why. If you don't know why, It's because everything in the world is beautiful and sometime one needs new perspective and insight on it.
I started taking 10mg on a Friday and took the previous dose plus 10mg each day following. By saturday I noticed bright things like tv, and marijuana grow lights were incredibly painful without shades. It was while watching across the universe, when I realized the vivid colours were incredibly intense and I should be more concerned about my eyes. After wearing glasses a short time the discomfort disappeared in a day with abstinence from psychedelics. Stay save everyone!
